mapper.sql: id,platform_order_id,order_state, buyer_user_id,buyer_name,shop_no, shop_name,order_cost,can_send, is_returned,is_refund,paid_time, sales_record_number,platform_order_status,order_fee, source_platform,is_union,is_split, is_resend,has_goods,district, city,province,man_street, second_street,close_date,man_phone, second_phone,fba_flag,seller_message, currency_code,currency_rate,item_total, shipping_fee,platform_fee,shipping_total_origin, item_total_origin,item_total_cost,subsidy_amount, country_name_en,country_name_cn
mapper.select:
select doi.id, doi.platform_order_id, doi.source_platform, doi.shop_name, doi.order_fee, round(doi.order_fee * doi.currency_rate,2) as cnyRealTimeAmount, round(doi.order_fee * doi.cny_settle_rate,2) as cny_settle_amount, doi.buyer_name, doi.man_phone, doi.second_phone, doi.man_street, doi.second_street, doi.country_name_cn, doi.order_state, doi.correction_status, doi.create_time, doi.platform_order_id, doi.delivery_time, doi.charge_name, doi.dept_name, doi.platform_create_time from dmp_order_info doi
and doi.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformOrderId},'%')
and doi.shop_name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and doi.source_platform like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and doi.order_state = #{params.orderState}
and doi.platform_create_time >= #{params.createTime_begin}::timestamp
and doi.platform_create_time <= #{params.createTime_end}::timestamp
and doi.delivery_time >= #{params.deliveryTime_begin}::timestamp
and doi.delivery_time <= #{params.deliveryTime_end}::timestamp
${params.param}

select doi.platform_order_id, doi.source_platform, doi.shop_name, doi.order_fee, round(doi.order_fee * doi.currency_rate,2) as cnyRealTimeAmount, round(doi.order_fee * doi.cny_settle_rate,2) as cny_settle_amount, doi.buyer_name, doi.man_phone, doi.second_phone, doi.man_street, doi.second_street, doi.country_name_cn, case when doi.order_state = 2 then '配货中' when doi.order_state = 3 then '已发货' when doi.order_state = 4 then '已完成' when doi.order_state = 5 then '已作废' else '' end order_state_name, case when doi.correction_status = 2 then '配货中' when doi.correction_status = 3 then '已发货' when doi.correction_status = 4 then '已完成' when doi.correction_status = 5 then '已作废' else '' end correction_status_name, doi.correction_status, doi.create_time, doi.platform_order_id, doi.delivery_time, doi.charge_name, doi.currency_code, doi.dept_name, doi2.sku_no, doi2.item_name, doi2.sell_price, doi2.quantity, round(doi2.sell_price * doi2.quantity,2) as sellAmount from dmp_order_info doi left join dmp_order_item doi2 on doi.id = doi2.order_id
and doi.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformOrderId},'%')
and doi.shop_name like concat('%',#{params.shopName},'%')
and doi.platform_order_id like concat('%',#{params.platformName},'%')
and doi.order_state = #{params.orderState}
and doi.create_time >= #{params.createTime_begin}::timestamp
and doi.create_time <= #{params.createTime_end}::timestamp
and doi.delivery_time >= #{params.deliveryTime_begin}::timestamp
and doi.delivery_time <= #{params.deliveryTime_end}::timestamp
${params.param}
